method: Release pipkin --engine-worker using the same native protocol as the desktop; isolated real-account profile
limitations: Expiry was forced into the past in the isolated profile; no wait for natural expiry.
Imported source was a copied frozen Pi fixture, not private production session history.
Lifecycle calls used the release native worker protocol; desktop sign-in is covered separately.
harness_corrections: First refresh assertion ran after metadata-only AuthReuse and before a model request; corrected to send a request before inspecting rotation. No provider refresh failure was observed.

A sandboxed ps check hid the running host process. A redundant desktop launch then hit the intentional single-writer engine lock, showing the restart cap. Host-visible process/lock inspection confirmed the original worker was healthy; closed only the duplicate test window and resumed the original sign-in.
